comments.author: slesaad
comments.body:
im confused as to why these two functions are needed `applyCogFieldsToUrl` and `appendCogDynamicParams` 🤔 

doesn't `applyCogFieldsToUrl` handle both the cases already?

also there's some inconsistencies between the two:
- rescale format: `rescale=0,100` vs `rescale=[0,100]`
- one is gated behind `cogTransform === true` (think this should always be the case)

comments.author: slesaad
comments.body:
another reason we'd like it gated is we might use a tilelayer that doesn't support these query params (or uses different values for the same query params) - we don't want those to be overriden by the titiler based params

i was working on adding a new source type for tilelayer to support the titiler urls in [this PR](https://github.com/NASA-IMPACT/MMGIS/pull/64) but i like your way better - but i think it needs to be behind some conditional

there's also the "Use TiTiler" confition in the "COG" tab which kinda makes sense but also feels interchangeable with the "COG transform" conditional. What do you think?

comments.author: dzole0311
comments.body:
Consolidated the two utils and addressed some of the inconsistencies here: https://github.com/NASA-IMPACT/MMGIS/pull/62/commits/3129581feb7cf3e25f14462dfc1537261b5e3530

> there's also the "Use TiTiler" confition in the "COG" tab which kinda makes sense but also feels interchangeable with the "COG transform" conditional. What do you think?

i still find the MMGIS config UI ux/semantics a little bit ambiguous. I think what would be helpful is to come up with a small "behavior matrix" (eg. source type and flags > expected URL/param behavior) and then translate code/UI to that. There we can also consider how gating should be implemented (eg. type-driven or with other flags).

1  /**
     2   * Shared utilities for building COG tile URLs.
     3   * Used by both the Leaflet per-tile middleware (getTileUrl) and the DeckGL
     4   * static URL builder (makeTileLayer), so the same params are applied
     5   * regardless of which engine is active.
     6   */
     7  
     8  /**
     9   * Adds `asset_` prefix to bare band references (b1, B2, etc.) in a TiTiler
    10   * expression string. No-ops if the expression is empty or already prefixed.
    11   *
    12   * @param {string} expression
    13   * @returns {string}
    14   */
    15  export function processExpression(expression) {
    16      if (!expression || expression.trim() === '') return expression
    17      return expression.replace(/(?<!\w)([bB])(\d+)/g, 'asset_$1$2')
    18  }
    19  
    20  /**
    21   * Merges COG layer field values into a URL as query params.
    22   * Params already present in the URL always win; fields only fill in what's missing.
    23   * Used for DeckGL layers with direct TiTiler URLs (not COG:-prefixed).
    24   *
    25   * @param {string} url - The tile URL (may already have query params)
    26   * @param {object} layerObj - Layer config object
    27   * @returns {string} URL with COG params merged in
    28   */
    29  export function applyCogFieldsToUrl(url: string, layerObj: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    30      if (!url) return url
    31      const qIdx = url.indexOf('?')
    32      const path = qIdx === -1 ? url : url.slice(0, qIdx)
    33      const params = new URLSearchParams(qIdx === -1 ? '' : url.slice(qIdx + 1))
    34  
    35      const expression = (layerObj.currentCogExpression || layerObj.cogExpression) as string | undefined
    36      if (expression && expression.trim() !== '') {
    37          // Expression takes precedence over bidx; remove band params and set expression.
    38          params.delete('bidx')
    39          params.set('expression', processExpression(expression))
    40      }
    41  
    42      if (layerObj.cogColormap && !params.has('colormap_name'))
    43          params.set('colormap_name', layerObj.cogColormap as string)
    44  
    45      const cogMin = layerObj.currentCogMin ?? layerObj.cogMin
    46      const cogMax = layerObj.currentCogMax ?? layerObj.cogMax
    47      if (cogMin != null && cogMax != null && !params.has('rescale'))
    48          params.set('rescale', `${cogMin},${cogMax}`)
    49  
    50      if (layerObj.cogResampling && !params.has('resampling'))
    51          params.set('resampling', layerObj.cogResampling as string)
